summary.result: The USPED estimated results can be used to complement USLE results in developing effective erosion control plans.
summary.background: It has been well known that soil erosion and sediments from alpine agricultural fields are causing severe water quality and turbidity problems in receiving waters.
summary.method: To accomplish this end, an effective erosion control plans should be developed based on scientific research, not by rule of thumb.
